title: Government Strengthens Cyber Security Capacity of Women Officials through CyberShakti Programme
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Electronics & IT

Government Strengthens Cyber Security Capacity of Women Officials through CyberShakti Programme

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
12 AUG 2026 1:37PM by PIB Delhi

The Government has taken note of the recommendation of the 2026 Standing Committee Report on the Empowerment of Women to scale up the CyberShakti programme. The programme was approved for a period of two years starting from October 2024 with the objective of enhancing cyber security awareness and strengthening cyber security skills among women government officials. The second phase of the project is recommended by the working group on Cyber Security in May 2026.



A total of 978 women government officials including women police officers, cyber cell personnel and women officials dealing with victims of cybercrimes have been trained under the CyberShakti programme since its inception in 2024 through 2-week Virtual Instructor-Led Training (VILT) mode online training programme and one-week offline residential training programme.
